propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep executes one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, causing multi-minute stalls for all writers in the fleet.
Per-ticket position-commit map misses fall through to per-event wildcard git log walks with leading-wildcard pathspecs that defeat optimizations, making deployed cost worse than one-walk-per-ticket.
The sweep does not re-yield mid-run, so writers arriving after sweep start must wait for the entire run to complete rather than inserting between tickets.
The sweep stages changes with unscoped git add -A, allowing in-flight event files from concurrent writers to be committed into the compaction commit under a misleading message.

Moving the single position-commit map build outside the lock and consulting it per-ticket removes the history walk cost from the critical section while keeping the fold inside the lock to eliminate prep/commit race windows.
